newsitem.title: THAILAND: TransCanada said keen on Thai pipelines.
newsitem.headline: TransCanada said keen on Thai pipelines.

text.p: TransCanada Pipelines Ltd is interested in two pipeline projects in Thailand, an executive at state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand said on Thursday.

PTT Governor Pala Sukhavesh said the agency, TransCanada and Thai Petroleum Pipeline Co Ltd are conducting feasibility study on the two projects which have a projected investment cost of around 20 billion baht ($800 million).

These projects include a 583-km pipeline from central Saraburi province to the northern province of Lampang. The other is a 300-km pipeline from Saraburi to the northeastern province of Khon Kaen, Pala said.
If the projects are financially feasible, the three agencies will set up a joint venture to build and operate the pipelines, he said.
The projects were part of Thailand's effort to alleviate traffic congestion and pollution from overland transportation of oil, he said.
